verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a built-in sandbox that limits what the agent process and its children can read, write and reach on the network, using Landlock on Linux and Seatbelt on macOS (docs-32). That covers the code, tools and network elements of the story. Worktree sessions add filesystem isolation between parallel agents (docs-33), and permission deny rules give extra command-level control (docs-44). missing for 10: depth beyond a single doc snippet (configuration options, default policy, network allowlisting details), Windows sandbox coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as claimed.
